summary: Personalized recipes feature fully tested and working. Backend API GET /api/recipes/personalized/{profile_id}?lang=de returns sorted recipes with relevance_score and relevance_tags. Frontend correctly displays 'Passend fuer dich' section with 28 relevant recipes and 'Weitere Rezepte' section with score-0 recipes. Relevance tags (Eisenreich, Reich an Omega-3, Immunstaerkend, Gegen Muedigkeit) display as teal badges on recipe cards.

issues: data-testid attributes on TouchableOpacity may not be queryable in React Native Web - functional but not ideal for automation

details: Response has recipes array and profile_diet field
All recipes have relevance_score (numeric) and relevance_tags (list)
relevance_tags limited to max 3 per recipe
Omega-3 deficiency -> 'Reich an Omega-3' tags working
28 recipes with score>0, 9 recipes with score=0
Max time filter works (tested with max_time=15)
'Gesundheitsprofil erforderlich' card displays when no health_profile_id
'Passend fuer dich' section shows with 28 count badge
Recipe cards display with relevance tags (teal badges)
Tags visible: Eisenreich, Reich an Omega-3, Immunstaerkend, Gegen Muedigkeit
Category filter chips visible (Energie & Müdigkeit, Kopfschmerzen, Stress, Verdauung)
Recipe card click navigates to detail page

critical_code_review_comments: Good implementation of DEFICIENCY_RECIPE_MAP for nutrient-to-tag mapping with German/Italian labels
COMPLAINT_TAG_MAP correctly maps complaints to recipe symptom_tags
RISK_SCORE properly weights high=3, medium=2, low=1 points
relevance_tags correctly limited to 3 tags per recipe
Frontend correctly splits recipes into relevant (score>0) and other (score=0) sections
AsyncStorage used properly for health_profile_id persistence
Profile-required state shows appropriate message and CTA button
Teal badges (#2C8C99 background) provide good visual indicator for relevance tags
